exchanges.input: How did daily sales change across September 2047, November 2047 and February 2048? Use our semantic-model sell-out measures. Give one table with each product's average kg per calendar day in the three months, rounded to one decimal. Identify the products behind the change.
exchanges.answer:
Snapshot cutoff: 2048-03-03. Using semantic-model sell-out measures, average sales per calendar day changed as follows:

Product	Sep 2047 kg/day	Nov 2047 kg/day	Feb 2048 kg/day
dark70	211.5	147.6	227.2
milk	190.4	106.9	169.9
seasonal_gianduja	50.1	100.2	67.1

Products behind the change

The September-to-November decline was led by milk (−83.5 kg/day) and dark70 (−63.9 kg/day), partly offset by seasonal_gianduja (+50.1 kg/day).
The November-to-February rebound was driven by dark70 (+79.6 kg/day) and milk (+63.0 kg/day); seasonal_gianduja fell by 33.1 kg/day.
Relative to September, February was higher for dark70 (+15.7 kg/day) and seasonal_gianduja (+17.0 kg/day), while milk remained lower (−20.5 kg/day).

Complete result table: result_0.json.

exchanges.input: Does the sales pattern also appear in supply? Use Lakehouse SQL to compare September 2047, November 2047 and February 2048. Combine dark70 and milk and return one row per month with started, released and shipped kg per calendar day, rounded to one decimal. Keep production flows distinct from sell-out.
exchanges.answer:
Snapshot cutoff: 2048-03-03.

Yes. For combined Dark70 + Milk, supply broadly follows the sell-out pattern: both drop sharply in November 2047 and recover in February 2048.

September 2047: started 407.2, released 401.9, shipped 397.2 kg/day.
November 2047: started 253.1, released 253.1, shipped 253.1 kg/day—the low point, matching sell-out’s decline to 254.6 kg/day.
February 2048: started 406.2, released 408.0, shipped 404.9 kg/day—recovering alongside sell-out at 397.2 kg/day.

Production flows remain distinct from customer sell-out; the alignment is a measured monthly pattern, not evidence of causation. Full three-row result: result_0.json.

WITH RequestedMonths AS (
    SELECT '2047-09' AS [Month]
    UNION ALL SELECT '2047-11'
    UNION ALL SELECT '2048-02'
), CalendarDays AS (
    SELECT
        LEFT(v.[Date], 7) AS [Month],
        COUNT(*) AS CalendarDays
    FROM dbo.virtualday_v1_3df09908ad3274f2 AS v
    INNER JOIN RequestedMonths AS rm
        ON LEFT(v.[Date], 7) = rm.[Month]
    GROUP BY LEFT(v.[Date], 7)
), SelloutMonthly AS (
    SELECT
        LEFT(v.[Date], 7) AS [Month],
        s.Product,
        SUM(s.SoldKg) AS SoldKg
    FROM dbo.sellout_v1_3df09908ad3274f2 AS s
    INNER JOIN dbo.virtualday_v1_3df09908ad3274f2 AS v
        ON s.[Date] = v.[Date]
    INNER JOIN RequestedMonths AS rm
        ON LEFT(v.[Date], 7) = rm.[Month]
    WHERE s.Product IN ('dark70', 'milk')
    GROUP BY LEFT(v.[Date], 7), s.Product
), SelloutCombined AS (
    SELECT
        [Month],
        SUM(SoldKg) AS SoldKg
    FROM SelloutMonthly
    GROUP BY [Month]
), ProductionDailyProduct AS (
    SELECT
        LEFT(v.[Date], 7) AS [Month],
        p.[Date],
        p.Product,
        SUM(p.StartedKg) AS StartedKg,
        SUM(p.ReleasedKg) AS ReleasedKg,
        SUM(p.ShippedKg) AS ShippedKg
    FROM dbo.productionflow_v1_3df09908ad3274f2 AS p
    INNER JOIN dbo.virtualday_v1_3df09908ad3274f2 AS v
        ON v.[Date] = p.[Date]
    INNER JOIN RequestedMonths AS rm
        ON LEFT(v.[Date], 7) = rm.[Month]
    WHERE p.Product IN ('dark70', 'milk')
    GROUP BY LEFT(v.[Date], 7), p.[Date], p.Product
), ProductionMonthly AS (
    SELECT
        [Month],
        Product,
        SUM(StartedKg) AS StartedKg,
        SUM(ReleasedKg) AS ReleasedKg,
        SUM(ShippedKg) AS ShippedKg
    FROM ProductionDailyProduct
    GROUP BY [Month], Product
), ProductionCombined AS (
    SELECT
        [Month],
        SUM(StartedKg) AS StartedKg,
        SUM(ReleasedKg) AS ReleasedKg,
        SUM(ShippedKg) AS ShippedKg
    FROM ProductionMonthly
    GROUP BY [Month]
)
SELECT
    rm.[Month],
    ROUND(CAST(sc.SoldKg AS decimal(19,4)) / cd.CalendarDays, 1) AS [Sold kg per calendar day],
    ROUND(CAST(pc.StartedKg AS decimal(19,4)) / cd.CalendarDays, 1) AS [Started kg per calendar day],
    ROUND(CAST(pc.ReleasedKg AS decimal(19,4)) / cd.CalendarDays, 1) AS [Released kg per calendar day],
    ROUND(CAST(pc.ShippedKg AS decimal(19,4)) / cd.CalendarDays, 1) AS [Shipped kg per calendar day]
FROM RequestedMonths AS rm
INNER JOIN CalendarDays AS cd
    ON cd.[Month] = rm.[Month]
LEFT JOIN SelloutCombined AS sc
    ON sc.[Month] = rm.[Month]
LEFT JOIN ProductionCombined AS pc
    ON pc.[Month] = rm.[Month]
ORDER BY rm.[Month];

exchanges.input: Has the company also reduced its backlog? Use the Lakehouse's observed company balances from 2047-11-01 through 2048-02-29. Plot daily backlog and finished stock as a native line chart. For November and February, report average observed backlog, last observed backlog and the number of observed dates. Use every available observation.
exchanges.answer:
Snapshot cutoff: 2048-03-03.

Yes—backlog was reduced by February. The average observed backlog fell from 983.0 kg in November 2047 to 533.3 kg in February 2048, and the final observed backlog fell from 1,119 kg to 0 kg.

Month	Average observed backlog	Last observed backlog	Observed dates
November 2047	983.0 kg	1,119 kg	30
February 2048	533.3 kg	0 kg	29

The native daily line chart plots observed backlog and finished stock for all 121 available observations from 2047-11-01 through 2048-02-29. Missing measurements were not imputed.

Files: result_2.json (daily data) and report_specs_4.json (native line-chart specification).

WITH Observations AS (
    SELECT
        [Date],
        BacklogKg,
        FinishedKg,
        CONVERT(char(7), CONVERT(date, [Date]), 120) AS [Month]
    FROM dbo.companyobservation_v1_3df09908ad3274f2
    WHERE [Date] >= '2047-11-01'
      AND [Date] <= '2048-02-29'
), Monthly AS (
    SELECT
        [Month],
        AVG(CAST(BacklogKg AS decimal(19, 4))) AS AverageObservedBacklogKg,
        MAX([Date]) AS LastObservationDate,
        COUNT(DISTINCT [Date]) AS ObservedDates
    FROM Observations
    WHERE [Month] IN ('2047-11', '2048-02')
    GROUP BY [Month]
)
SELECT
    o.[Date],
    o.BacklogKg AS DailyBacklogKg,
    o.FinishedKg AS DailyFinishedStockKg,
    o.[Month],
    CASE WHEN o.[Month] IN ('2047-11', '2048-02') THEN m.AverageObservedBacklogKg END AS AverageObservedBacklogKg,
    CASE WHEN o.[Month] IN ('2047-11', '2048-02') THEN last_o.BacklogKg END AS LastObservedBacklogKg,
    CASE WHEN o.[Month] IN ('2047-11', '2048-02') THEN m.ObservedDates END AS ObservedDates
FROM Observations AS o
LEFT JOIN Monthly AS m
    ON o.[Month] = m.[Month]
LEFT JOIN Observations AS last_o
    ON last_o.[Month] = m.[Month]
   AND last_o.[Date] = m.LastObservationDate
ORDER BY o.[Date] ASC;
